I swore that if we ever crossed paths again, I would make this personal.|audio = NullVoidNight3Wave20-2.ogg|[[Kronus (Narrator)|Kronus]] on Wave 20 ([[Blind Faith]])}} }} ==Description== '''Kronus''' was the first major boss that appeared in [[Blind Faith]] as part of the [[Null & Void Event]]. It had higher health than majority of the enemies in the event, though it was also one of the slowest. '''Kronus''' has four abilities: #''Time Scale'', which makes it change the [[Time Scale]] of the match to 0.2x, though '''Kronus''' will continue to walk at normal speed. During this period, the entire map will turn grey and [[Time Scale]] will no longer be possible to change by the player. #''Sweeping Ice'' makes '''Kronus''' spin its staff in the direction of a tower, summoning in an aftershock of ice that freezes towers for 5 seconds and deals 2,000 damage to units. #''Ice Storm'', where '''Kronus''' points its staff in the air, summoning 25 icicles from the sky that freeze towers for 5 seconds and deal 1,000 damage to units. #''Summon'' has '''Kronus''' point its staff, which summons in random enemies for 2 seconds. These can be the the [[Null Crook Boss]] (80% chance, 0.45 second delay), [[Null Warden]] (5% chance, 0.6 second delay) and [[Null Electroshocker]] (15% chance, 0.5 second delay). ==Logbook Description== "''When Trick or Threat Town was attacked, three brothers were saved by TDS from Lord Sinister. But the Town’s reputation was destroyed- some said it was too dangerous to visit. As the brothers left, Kronus found a God Shard that was left behind, along with Narrator. That’s when Narrator promised that Lord Exo would rebuild the town, and the brothers could live together once more.''" ==Appearance== '''Kronus''' is one of the [[Children of Exo]]. It is a figure shrouded in a red cloak, with cybernetic elements across its body, such as its mechanical left arm. '''Kronus''' also wears a grey mask, concealing its face, with what appears to be bullets crossed along its body. '''Kronus''' has a neon-green hourglass on its back, as well as wielding a staff with a shard of the [[God Cube]]. ==Event Strategy== As this enemy only appears through [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode, no strategy section is made for its current version. Instead, a strategy section for the one that appeared without [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode in [[Blind Faith]] is listed instead. *High DPS towers like the [[Accelerator]], [[Turret]], [[Ranger]] or [[Pursuit]] are recommended here. **As '''Kronus''' uses freezing attacks, stun immune towers do not have a large advantage here since it does not make them immune to freeze, though they can still be useful due to '''Kronus''' summoning in [[Null Electroshocker]]s. **The [[Commander]] and [[DJ Booth]] can be used to boost the statistics of your towers. *The [[Medic]] cannot be used here, as it cannot shield towers from freeze. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Animations}} KronusWalk.gif|Walking animation (31 October 2025 – Present) KronusTimeScale.gif|''Time Scale'' animation (31 October 2025 – Present) KronusSweepingIce.gif|''Sweeping Ice'' animation (31 October 2025 – Present) KronusIceStorm.gif|''Ice Storm'' animation (31 October 2025 – Present) KronusSummon.gif|Full ''Summon'' animation (31 October 2025 – Present) KronusDeath.gif|Escape animation (31 October 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Corpse Variants}} CorpseKronus.png|Second [[Corpse (Enemy)|Corpse]] variant, current version (31 October 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Promotional Images}} HexscapePI3.jpg|'''Kronus''' on a promotional image. {{GalleryHeader|Cutscenes}} Hexscape Night 1 Cutscene 1|'''Kronus''' in [[Failed Gateway]]'s second cutscene. ChildrenofExoMembers.png|'''Kronus''' on the Children of Exo member list. }} ==Trivia== *The [[Boss]] health bar for '''Kronus''' displays that it enters rage mode after reaching 75% of its health, however, when that happens, there are no actual changes on the enemy. **This is to be due to a leftover statistic which is a phase 2 threshold set to 75% of its health that appears to have been taken from the [[Frost Spirit]] due to them using the same threshold at the time, them sharing freeze based abilities that function similarly and '''Kronus''' having another unused statistic, this time a health multiplier for ''Roblox Winter Spotlight''. *'''Kronus''' first appeared in the [[Hexscape Event]], where it would be just known as "''???''". It would not be until the [[Null & Void Event]] that it would become an enemy. *The staff wielded by '''Kronus''' uses the same model as [[Krampus (Krampus Frosthold)|Krampus']] staff from [[Krampus' Revenge Event]]. *'''Kronus''' is named after [[wp:Cronus|Kronos]], the King of the Titans and god of time in Greek mythology. Hence having an ability, '''Time Scale''', that can manipulate time. *'''Kronus''' is unaffected by enemy appearance [[modifiers]], such as [[Talk Like a Pirate Day]]. ==Update History== *'''31 October 2025''' - [[v1.79.0]] **'''Kronus''' added. *'''26 November 2025''' - [[v1.80.0|v1.80.1b]] **'''Kronus''' removed from the main game, now appears exclusively in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode. *'''3 December 2025''' - [[v1.82.0]] **{{Bug}} Cannot be spawned in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode. *'''4 December 2025''' - [[v1.82.0]]b ** {{Bugfix}} Can now be spawned in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode. {{BlindFaith|[[Null Medic]]|Wave 18|Kronus|Wave 20|[[Null Beast]]|Wave 21}} {{ZombieNavBox}} [[Category:Bosses]]
